reason: After reviewing the full 10-K filing excerpt for Chemed Corporation (CHE), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) was disclosed by the company. The filing contains detailed business descriptions for both VITAS (hospice and palliative care) and Roto-Rooter (plumbing and water restoration services) segments, including revenue breakdowns, competitive landscape, regulatory environment, and operational details. However, the company did not provide any market size estimates, TAM figures, or addressable market quantifications for either segment. The filing does not contain references to market opportunity sizing, serviceable addressable market, or total market value disclosures that would constitute a company-disclosed TAM.
